Subject: Unexpected mid-month metering jump + VAT treatment

Hi Olga,

We're seeing a sharp usage jump on May 4–5 on our Redwood invoice that doesn't match any product change on our side. The line items show a 3x increase in embedding token counts versus our internal logs. Attached is a short excerpt from the invoice (orchid_invoices_excerpt.pdf).

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood provide the raw metering window CSV (per-request token counts + request_id) for May 3–6 so we can reconcile with our telemetry?
2) We're in the process of moving billing to our EU subsidiary (Orchid Labs Ltd, UK/EU tax ID provided by our finance team). Until we confirm the EU entity transfer, please confirm whether VAT has been applied and whether Redwood can reverse-charge once we provide the certificate.

We'd also like to request a temporary pause on collections for the disputed portion until reconciliation is complete — our AP team will not release payment for the disputed amount until the root cause is identified.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Rebecca Chen
Head of Finance, Orchid Labs
rebecca@orchidlabs.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-06T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-month metering jump + VAT treatment

Hi Rebecca — thanks for the heads up and the invoice excerpt. Looping in Rafael from Billing Ops and Ben (your account rep) — Rafael will pull the per-request export for the window you mentioned and surface any aggregation/windowing anomalies.

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce per-request token CSVs for May 3–6 (we'll redact PII) and will attach a sample within 24 hours.
- Regarding VAT: we can reclassify to reverse-charge if you provide the EU VAT registration evidence (certificate). Please attach that, and include the exact entity name and billing address you want on file.
- Collections: I can't unilaterally pause a collections flow permanently, but we can put the disputed amount on hold while Billing Ops performs a forensic review. Ben, can you confirm a temporary hold on collections for OL-9876?

Next steps: Rafael will send an initial findings email and the CSV. If you have a PDF of the EU entity registration, please send it here. We'll aim to produce a provisional credit proposal if we identify duplicated tokens or windowing mismatch.

Olga Petrov
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-month metering jump + VAT treatment — preliminary analysis

Rebecca / Olga — I pulled the per-request export for account OL-9876 and the May 3–6 window and attached a short sampling as orchid_usage_window.csv (columns: timestamp, request_id, model, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, total_tokens). A few quick observations: 

1) Aggregation window shift: on 2026-05-04 00:00:00 UTC we rolled a small change to the streaming embed pipeline which changed the ingestion boundary for long-running streams. For most customers this is a noop, but for Orchid we see ~1.08x token duplication on a subset of multipart streaming requests that re-opened the session and re-sent prefixes.

2) Tokenization delta: around 2026-05-04 02:40:00 UTC there are ~18k requests where total_tokens in Redwood logs is higher than the request payload token estimate by 20–35 tokens each — this is consistent with a different tokenizer model falling back during a short window.

Estimate of disputed volume (prelim): 1,124,600 tokens. Using your published rate card this maps to ~$1,124.60. That is provisional — I recommend a full audit before a final credit.

Proposed interim approach:
- Place the disputed amount on collection hold (Olga/Ben to confirm).
- Issue a provisional credit memo for 1,124,600 tokens pending full audit.
- If Orchid provides EU VAT registration certificate and we verify entity transfer, we will apply reverse-charge treatment retroactively to the invoices in question (requires finance sign-off).

Attachments: orchid_usage_window.csv (sample).

I'll start a billing remediation ticket and share the ticket ID in the next message.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
